essence: The five weapons are to be employed in sequence as an additional ritual element.
After offering, the practitioner should pour the oblation remnant in the designated place.
The practitioner should install five deities in vessels filled with the five cow products.
The offering and oblation should be presented with their own auspicious mantras.
The ritual causes protection and the presence of Kamalā to increase.
